finding: FUZZ-M7D-1 (the 10-minute fuzz smoke of the M7D fixes, 2026-10-01; harness, not program): on a fresh pump curve a `shock` buys up to 98 % of `rT`, a short opens (selling its `Q` into the curve), a second `shock` buys 98 % of `rT` again — now `Q > rT`, so `close_short`, `liquidate` and `expire` all refuse `CurveStraddle` (ARCH §5.1: a buy above `rT` reverts on pump). The wind-down's price restore moves the price at most 50× in one push, which left `rT` below `Q`, and its keeper had no straddle, so the position was still open after the closes, the keeper's exits, the deadlines, S3 and two days: the liveness oracle (I8 / I-P6, I-E11) fired. Replay: `shortwin-fuzz replay tests/fuzz/corpus/fuzz-m7d-1-curve-straddle-wind-down.json`.

resolution: Resolved in the fuzzer at M7D: on a market whose close refused `CurveStraddle` the wind-down completed the curve (a buy of `rT`: the straddle's first step, ARCH §5.4 — the in-house keeper's bundle, or anyone's completion) and, as for any completed curve, did not migrate it (`fuzz:wind-down-curve-completed`): the market was left `PumpMigrating` and the S3 path settled the position (`SolSettle(S3)`). The liveness oracle is unchanged. No program change. Closed by itself since pump-final (P2, the curve adapter on pump's v3): an exit of `Q > rT` completes the curve by pump's synthetic migration in its own instruction (`B̂_v3`; `CurveStraddle` is left only past what the would-be pool holds), so P7 removed the wind-down's completion step; the reproducer, kept and re-recorded for P7, now ends with the keeper's liquidation completing the curve synthetically (`liquidate:curve-differential-completes-synthetic`, `fuzz:exit-completes-curve-synthetic`; `smoke::fuzz_m7d_1_closes_by_synthetic_migration`). This file replays as a regression: the run must pass (`corpus_replays`).
